positions.title: Corporate Development / M&A (Embedded Advisor to Executive Leadership) – Interim
positions.description:
Served as an embedded advisor for Lacon Group, a well-established EMS company with modern facilities in Germany and Romania, in a complex sell-side M&A transaction, acting as a strategic liaison between management, the investment bank Carlsquare, legal advisors MWS, and current Private Equity Investor Fund Hannover Finanz. Provided hands-on support across all critical workstreams, including due diligence, virtual data room management, and day-to-day execution.

Signing of Transaction was completed on Dec 3rd 2025:
"The global EMS company Incap (NASDAQ:ICP1V) acquires Lacon Group, strengthening its position in the fast-growing defense sector and expanding offering to design and development services"

Key Contributions:

- Delivered end-to-end support to the Lacon Board of Directors across the full sell-side process, ensuring smooth execution and stakeholder alignment
- Acted as strategic intermediary between Lacon Group leadership and external advisors to maintain transaction momentum
- Managed the comprehensive internal documentation process for the Virtual Data Room (VDR), including Q&A, and due-diligence workflows
- Support in strategy and positioning workshops with potential buyers
- Relieved senior management with operational support, enabling focus on high-level decision-making

Post-Merger-Integration of Lacon Add-on Acquisition Lacon Montronic GmbH in Glinde (HH)

company.name: Incap
company.tagline: Electronics Manufacturing Services. Agile. Flexible. Efficient.
company.description:
Incap Corporation - flexible, agile and efficient electronics manufacturing services.

Incap is a globally operating electronics manufacturing service provider with factories in India, the UK, Estonia, Slovakia, USA, Germany, Romania, a sourcing team in Hong Kong and headquarters in Finland. Incap’s share has been listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd stock exchange since 1997.

Our solutions and services:
- Prototyping & Engineering Services
- PCB Assemblies​ Manufacturing​
- Box Build​ Assemblies​
- Customized solutions
- Cable & Harness Assemblies​
- Engineering services
- Original Design Manufacturing (ODM)​
- Magnetic Assemblies​
- After-sales services

In the Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) marketplace, Incap has a long history and reputation of high quality. This we want to nurture and take even further. Smart utilization of our existing capacity is the main source to cost efficiency and profitability. This also allows us to produce higher volumes without any significant new investment.

Flexible, Agile and Efficient. That is our orientation and promise to the EMS marketplace. Over the years we have learned that alongside the core EMS market demand of On Time Delivery, Quality and Cost efficiency, our customers expect their partners to be able to adjust to continuous change. That is how we develop and run our operations.

Read more: www.incapcorp.com
